items.title: Price increase takes effect (Kabel 250 tariff)
items.quote: zum 01.02.2027 erhöhen wir den Preis Ihres Tarifs „Kabel 250“ um 3,00 € auf 37,99 € im Monat (bisher 34,99 €).
items.computation: The letter states the new price of 37,99 €/month (up from 34,99 €) becomes effective on a fixed calendar date given in the letter: 01.02.2027. No calculation needed, the date is stated explicitly.

items.title: Special termination right due to price increase (no notice period)
items.quote: Sie dürfen den Vertrag deshalb innerhalb von drei Monaten nach Erhalt dieses Schreibens kostenlos und ohne Kündigungsfrist beenden, frühestens zum Wirksamwerden der Preisänderung.
items.computation: The letter grants a special termination right running for three months after 'Erhalt dieses Schreibens' (receipt of this letter). The letter itself is dated 18.11.2026 (Mittwoch) but does not state the actual delivery/receipt date. As no evidence of a later delivery date is given, the document date is used as a proxy for the receipt date (this is an assumption, see warnings). Applying §187 Abs. 1 BGB, the day of the triggering event (18.11.2026) is not counted; the period runs forward. Applying §188 Abs. 2 BGB for a period measured in months that is triggered by an event, the period ends on the day of the third following month that bears the same number as the event day, i.e. 18.02.2027. 18.02.2027 falls on a Thursday (not a Saturday, Sunday or NRW public holiday), so no extension under §193 BGB is required. The termination may only take effect at the earliest on 01.02.2027 (date the price increase becomes effective), but the declaration itself must reach the provider by 18.02.2027 at the latest, under this assumption.
